definition: A circular economy aims to reduce waste and demand for new resources by keeping products, components, and materials in use through design, reuse, repair, remanufacturing, or recycling.
entry_text: A circular economy aims to reduce waste and demand for new resources by keeping products, components, and materials in use through design, reuse, repair, remanufacturing, or recycling.
example: An appliance company replaces worn components in returned machines and sells the refurbished units instead of scrapping them.
label: Circular economy
